raw_segments.text: He walked on through the case room, passing an old man, bowed, spectacled, apronned.
Queer lot of stuff he must have put through his hands in his time.
Obituary notices, pubs ads, speeches, divorce suits, found drowned.
Nearing the end of his tether now.
Sober serious man with a bit in the savings bank, I'd say.
Wife a good cook and washer.
Daughter working the machine in the parlor.
